Eligibility criteria for vaccine:
Manitoba’s Meningococcal Outbreak Eligibility: 
In addition to the routine meningococcal immunizations offered at 12 months and in Grade 6, up to two doses may be offered to infants aged 6 weeks to under 12 months of age who:
live in an Indigenous community within Manitoba; or
travel regularly to Indigenous communities in Manitoba; or
have household visitors from Indigenous communities in Manitoba.
